decisions.approved_scope: The eight Figure 2 cycles represent a single catalyst reuse history, not eight independent catalyst preparations or replications.
revisions_applied: Clarified the evaluation-only inference boundary: recovered carryover denotes procedural reuse and implies neither complete material conservation nor identical catalyst composition across cycles.
Synchronized the source limitation and current review document with this scope.

decisions.approved_scope: Mixed reuse-history feedstock in the build-8-and-later top-up regime, with incomplete lot identity, mixture fraction, and prior-build assignment for build 8. History streams are distinct from original powder lots; the bulk R index does not establish exact genealogy. The downstream exact_parent_lot_count remains null and complete_assignment_available remains false.

Regular staircase outcome-dependent stress assignment to a new specimen. The accepted 295 MPa and 355 MPa values are protocol-derived, not reconstructed observations. Random specimen extraction and protocol order do not establish independent stress randomization; allocation dependence does not establish specimen failure correlation. The fixed-stress observed replicate count remains null.

The N1000 paired-fixed subset has 100 paired realizations, 200 executions, and 100 pair-level values. Phase reversal relates the initial fields of two separate executions and does not constitute an independent second initial-condition draw or imply perfectly anticorrelated evolved observables. The accepted pair-average aggregation does not establish an effective sample size for every observable.

The 100 LENS2 members comprise 50 original and 50 SMBB protocol members under the official initialization mapping. The SMBB half includes other documented implementation changes, so the between-half contrast does not isolate smoothing alone. Initialization dates are not forcing treatments. Reported small or undetected impacts do not establish identical implementations or a single-variable causal contrast. The proposed references and downstream schema are unchanged.
revisions_applied: Replaced the E007-Q02 evidence rationale with the author-reviewed wording distinguishing the existence of additional implementation changes from the source-reported impact evaluations.

decisions.approved_scope: Exact equality of all eight coded factor settings across separate executions defines complete treatment replication. The author accepted 20 runs, 18 distinct settings, repeated table-column groups [11,12] and [13,14], 16 singleton settings, and two pure-error degrees of freedom. Table positions do not establish execution order, sign complementarity is not treatment equality, response differences do not negate treatment equality, and the source variance-related degrees of freedom are not all pure error. The source note now acknowledges Table 1 and retains the unresolved temperature-description discrepancy for physical-condition reconstruction.
revisions_applied: Replaced the incorrect factor-dictionary limitation with the exact author-reviewed source note, synchronized its review-issue copies, and added the Table 1 inspection location.

decisions.approved_scope: The author accepted the shared DC-voltage reference-calibration contribution and the Cal-Lab bracketing average, with two compared laboratory results across three calibration visits. The shared covariance subtraction remains 2*u_B(std_DCV)^2 and the exact effective replication count remains null. S2 inclusion is approved as a counting/dependence judgment about shared reference provenance, without expansion to the full uncertainty budget, other electrical quantities, effective sample size, or perfect correlation.

The author accepted complementary assignment within each four-hour EU and the distinction between assigned-unseeded and physical exposure. The downstream outcome retains 154 original EUs, 118 quality-controlled EUs and joint assignment events, 236 EU-by-range records, and a false independent-range-draws claim. Cross-range contamination does not redefine assigned treatment/control; the 21 transport cases and 18 modeled enhancement cases do not supply per-EU exposure labels. S2 inclusion is approved without effect-size, p-value, or causal conclusions.
